content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Pakistan, digital creators face significant restrictions when trying to sell their products online due to platform limitations like Stripe and PayPal. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, providing a solution for creators to build and deploy their own digital stores on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with automatic crypto payment processing and full data ownership.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to COREMERCH's success lies in its ability to provide a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, all without relying on conventional platforms. This is achieved through the use of free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Apps Script, which provide the necessary backend logic and hosting capabilities. By leveraging these tools, creators can build and deploy their own digital stores, free from the restrictions imposed by traditional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to have a few things in place. First, you'll need to choose the right stack for your needs, either Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 is ideal for smaller stores, using GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02 is better suited for larger stores, utilizing Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You'll also need to set up your payment and delivery pipeline, which will be covered in more detail later.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your digital store. This involves integrating NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low fee of 0.5%. You'll also need to configure your store to deliver products instantly upon payment confirmation. This can be achieved using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which provide free file storage and delivery capabilities. By leveraging these tools, you can create a seamless and automated payment and delivery process.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. This involves deploying your store to either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, depending on your chosen stack. You'll then need to test your store on the mainnet, ensuring that everything is working as expected. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can start processing transactions in as little as 48 hours, giving you a significant head start over traditional platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is up and running, you'll need to consider scaling to meet growing demand. This involves optimizing your store's performance, ensuring that it can handle increased traffic and transactions. You'll also need to monitor your store's analytics, identifying areas for improvement and making data-driven decisions. With COREMERCH's scaling playbook, you'll have the tools and expertise needed to take your store to the next level, achieving long-term success and growth.
